Attach an updated CV, photocopies of required certificates (educational and experience, as applicable), a copy of your Aadhaar Card, a copy of your PAN Card, and a latest passport-size coloured photograph.
Place the completed application and documents in a sealed envelope, superscribing on top the post applied for.

Submit the sealed envelope on or before 15 September 2026, up to 5:00 p.m., either in person or by post/courier, addressed to: The Managing Director, The Panipat Urban Co-Operative Bank Ltd., 3rd City Centre, #932-935/8, GT Road, Panipat, Haryana (132103).

The Bank does not charge any kind of fee from any candidate for the application form or any part of the recruitment process. The prescribed application form is available only on the Bank's official website.

content_sections.heading: Panipat Urban Co-operative Bank Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates may be contacted and required to appear for a Personal Interview/Assessment/Written Test, as per Bank requirements, covering Banking knowledge, General Awareness, and Aptitude, depending on the position applied for. The matter shall be subject to the sole discretion of the Bank, whose decision shall be final and binding on all concerned. The selected candidate may be posted at any branch of the Bank.

faq.question: Q1. What is Panipat Urban Co-operative Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contract-basis recruitment drive by The Panipat Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd. for 19 posts across its branches in Kaithal, Jagadhari, Yamunanagar, Panchkula, Chandigarh, Ludhiana, and other proposed branches.

faq.question: Q2. How many posts are available?
faq.answer: 19 posts in total: Senior Accountant (3), Junior Accountant (3), Senior Clerk (3), and Clerk-cum-Cashier/Field Supervisor (10).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: B.Com/BBA/BCA/MBA (Finance & Marketing) with banking experience for Senior Accountant, Junior Accountant, and Senior Clerk; B.Com/BBA/BCA/B.Tech (CSE/IT)/B.E. (CSE/IT)/M.Com/MBA (Finance & Marketing) for Clerk-cum-Cashier/Field Supervisor.

faq.question: Q5. What is the experience requirement?
faq.answer: Minimum 7 years for Senior Accountant, 5 years for Junior Accountant, and 2 years for Senior Clerk, all in Banking; not specified for Clerk-cum-Cashier/Field Supervisor.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: No. The Bank does not charge any fee for the application form or any part of the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Panipat Urban Co-operative Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By submitting a handwritten Application Form (downloaded from the Bank's website) along with a CV, certificates, Aadhaar, PAN, and photograph, in a sealed envelope, at the Bank's Head Office in Panipat, on or before 15 September 2026.
